open_in_system_player()[source]

Opne the video at the current frame in the system’s default video player. This will attempt to use commonly used Ubuntu video players that support seeking to a specific timestamp and open the video.

If none are found, it will fall back to xdg-open which will open the video in the default video player, but not at the specific timestamp.

run()

Run the worker thread to process the video. This method is executed in a separate thread. It emits the finished signal when processing is complete, or the error signal if an error occurs.
